display.purpose: Source Serif 4, static/fonts/source-serif-4-latin-wght-normal.woff2; variable weight 200–900, preloaded locally. Desktop reaches 90px; 57px at 760px and 54px at 520px.

headline.purpose: Source Serif 4; 34px desktop, 30px at 1000px, 29px at 520px. The static detector’s flat-hierarchy warning did not resolve the absolute linked stylesheet; rendered hierarchy is confirmed.

body.purpose: Source Serif 4, 16px/1.55. Detail text uses 16px/1.7; 15px on phones.

description.purpose: Source Serif 4; maximum 64ch, 18px desktop and 16px at 520px.

label.purpose: Bricolage, static/fonts/bricolage-grotesque.ttf; variable weight 200–800, preloaded locally. Disclosure/navigation labels use this local sans stack.

date.purpose: Bricolage with tabular numerals; 29px desktop, 25px at 1000px, 20px at 520px. Supporting dates use 12px desktop and 11px on phones.

motion.name: details-layout
motion.value: block-size 420ms var(--ease), opacity 300ms ease-out, content-visibility 420ms allow-discrete
motion.purpose: Only inside @supports (interpolate-size: allow-keywords) and selector(::details-content); native disclosures remain functional without it.

motion.name: state-feedback
motion.purpose: Plus/minus indicators rotate; link arrows move 2px right/up on hover.

motion.name: project-image
motion.purpose: Angla app screenshot scales to 1.035 only on fine-pointer hover.

motion.name: theme
motion.purpose: Body theme change. Theme button hover uses a separate 150ms background transition.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Disables animation, transitions, smooth scrolling, and image/arrow spatial hover effects. Source-verified fallback; motion browser evidence is Chromium only.

components.name: Native work disclosure
components.description: Seven work disclosures and two profile disclosures (Toolkit; Education & awards) are independently expandable, initially closed, and do not require JavaScript. Work labels include visually hidden company/role context; profile summaries use 60px minimum height. Keyboard focus is a 2px accent outline, offset 5px.
components.html:
Read more at Greenstone Financial Services — Senior Software Engineer
  • Feature delivery and platform observability.
components.css: .ds-details{margin-top:14px;color:var(--ink,#49313e);background:var(--paper,#f3e7e0);font:16px/1.55 var(--serif,"Source Serif 4",Georgia,serif)}.ds-details summary{cursor:pointer;list-style:none;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:20px;font:13px/1.5 var(--sans,Bricolage,sans-serif);min-height:44px}.ds-details summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}.ds-details summary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#803b55);outline-offset:5px}.ds-sr{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip-path:inset(50%);white-space:nowrap;border:0}.ds-icon{position:relative;width:20px;height:20px;display:block;flex:none}.ds-icon::before,.ds-icon::after{content:"";position:absolute;background:currentColor;left:2px;right:2px;top:9px;height:1.5px}.ds-icon::after{transform:rotate(90deg);transition:transform 250ms var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1))}.ds-details[open]>summary .ds-icon::after{transform:rotate(0)}.ds-detail-body{padding:8px 0 18px;color:var(--muted,#735c65);font-size:16px;line-height:1.7}.ds-detail-body ul{padding-left:20px;margin:10px 0 0}@supports(interpolate-size:allow-keywords) and selector(::details-content){.ds-details{interpolate-size:allow-keywords}.ds-details::details-content{block-size:0;overflow:clip;opacity:0;transition:block-size 420ms var(--ease,cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)),opacity 300ms ease-out,content-visibility 420ms allow-discrete}.ds-details[open]::details-content{block-size:auto;opacity:1}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-details::details-content,.ds-icon::after{transition:none!important}}

components.name: Theme toggle
components.description: Light-state appearance below. Existing templates/base.html JavaScript reveals the button, restores localStorage theme, toggles data-theme, and synchronizes the accessible action label and theme-color meta. Light is the default; dark swaps the six root colors without changing hierarchy. This HTML/CSS excerpt does not duplicate the production JavaScript.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-theme-toggle" aria-label="Switch to dark theme"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M21 12.8A9 9 0 1 1 11.2 3a7 7 0 0 0 9.8 9.8Z"/></svg></button>

narrative.overview: Chronicle is production visual authority. Historical prototype records remain explorations. Templates read `data/resume.toml`: ten roles appear in seven groups. The separate print résumé route remains unchanged.
keyCharacteristics: Rose paper and wine ink become deep plum and pale text in dark mode. Rules divide content; accent marks the spine, focus, and links.
Local Source Serif 4 carries names and reading text; local Bricolage carries dates, metadata, navigation, and controls.
dos: Do preserve concise summaries, canonical roles, visible focus, keyboard access, and reduced motion.
donts: Don't promote historical mockups into production authority or hide initial content behind animation.
